operational-example.copy: Use Date Picker to capture one operational date with locale, selected value, unavailable dates, and validation states.

scenario.title: Service scheduling
scenario.meta: One date, visible value, calendar affordance
rationale: Date Picker keeps one date field, calendar affordance, and validation state together.
It supports locale and disabled dates without becoming a reporting filter.
Use a pattern when users choose ranges, shortcuts, comparisons, or dashboard windows.

items.rule: Names the date purpose in visible text.
Shows the selected value in readable format.
Opens date choice without replacing the label.
Shows month and day targets when active.
Marks the current value with state and text.

accessibility.statePrecedence: disabled, error, warning, selected, focus, hover, default
items: Associate the label and selected date with the input.
Support keyboard navigation when the calendar is open.
Expose disabled dates and unavailable reasons.
Keep selected date visible as text.
Do not use for date ranges or reporting windows.

variants.copy: Date Picker has one package-owned calendar field variant for one operational date. Ranges, shortcuts, read-only summaries, and reporting windows belong in patterns or sibling components.

demos.label: With max date
demos.helper: Dates after policy end are unavailable.

states.copy: Date Picker states communicate focus, selected, warning, error, and disabled behavior without becoming Date Range Picker.

variant-state-behavior.copy: Date Picker has one calendar field variant; state defines availability and validation while range logic stays in patterns.

full-width.copy: Date Picker can fill forms and drawers while calendar targets remain usable and selected text remains visible.

responsive-layout-patterns.copy: Use large day targets on touch viewports and move ranges, presets, or comparison windows into patterns.

viewport-organization.copy: Date Picker stays one field; viewport rules decide target size and calendar placement, not reporting behavior.

items.title: Phone
items.rule: Use large field and day targets.

items.title: Tablet
items.rule: Keep selected date and calendar close together.

items.title: Desktop
items.rule: Use standard density in admin forms unless the surrounding layout is dense.

playground.copy: Use the playground to verify label, selected value, min/max, state, density, and one-date calendar behavior before composing reporting patterns.

api-foundations.copy: Date Picker API exposes label, value, placeholder, min, max, density, state, invalid, disabled, and local change events while Design System owns calendar geometry, focus, locale, and accessibility.

props.name: placeholder
props.notes: Fallback copy when no date is selected.

props.name: helper
props.notes: Helper text below the field using the shared field rhythm.

props.name: error
props.notes: Validation message; also drives error state when present.

props.name: density
props.notes: Maps field and day target rhythm to Design System Density.

props.name: state
props.notes: Documents the visual and validation state of the one-date field.

props.name: invalid
props.notes: Sets invalid semantics on the trigger for validation errors.

props.name: onValueChange
props.notes: Called when a date is selected.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.notes: Called when the local calendar panel opens or closes.

groups.title: Use
items: Keep selected date visible as text.
Respect locale and disabled date rules.

groups.title: Avoid
items: Do not use for reporting ranges.
Do not hide unavailable dates in color only.
Do not make the calendar pointer-only.

rejectIf: The field has no visible label.
The component owns date range behavior.

miel.copy: MIEL treats Date Picker as one date field. Agents may place it when a single date is known, but humans confirm locale, disabled dates, validation copy, and whether the task is actually a range pattern.
canDecide: Use Date Picker for service, document, invoice, or scheduling dates.
Use min and max when date availability is known.
Use warning when the date is outside policy but still visible.
mustAsk: The user needs a range, shortcut, or comparison window.
Disabled date rules or locale are unclear.
The date changes financial, safety, or compliance decisions.
rejectIf: The field has no visible label.
miel.handoff: I am using Date Picker for one operational date. Please confirm locale, min or disabled rules, validation copy, selected value format, and whether this should be a range pattern.
